Post Date: 2025-04-07T17:05:52Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Unable to return to meshtastic firmware
Description: Hi,
After flashing meshcore firmware on T1000-e, playing around I have decided to move back to the default meshtastic firmware. Unfortunately I am unable to do so.

1. "Custom" firmware from the flasher - timeouts
2. Flasher -> T1000e -> enter DFU -> back -> custom firmware - timeouts
3. `meshtastic` python client fails as well with timeouts.

Currently, I can only re-flash the meshcore firmware, which is far from optimal.
Any advice would be greatly appreciated.

1. The actual physical T1000-e hardware device
2. Access to the specific firmware files
3. The ability to connect the device to a computer and flash firmware
4. Potentially specialized tools for entering DFU mode

This is impossible to dockerize because:
- It requires physical hardware (the T1000-e device)
- It involves hardware-specific interactions (firmware flashing)

No amount of code analysis alone can verify if a solution to this firmware flashing issue works - it must be tested on the actual hardware.
